scope: Approved EXPLORATORY KRX business dates 2026-01-01..2026-10-15 and required night boundary; other Final OOS excluded

A.spot_funding: Sufficient assumed amount, not user balance

reverse: Theoretical borrow; sale proceeds restricted plus 100% current spot notional collateral reserved; borrow fee UNVERIFIED
admission: Check spot notional+fees+slippage, cap, nonnegative future operating cash, current maintenance and post-cost initial margin at next contiguous observed open
maintenance_policy: On observed deficit block new orders and unwind whole cycle at next contiguous observed open; actual broker timing unverified; never invent gap fills
roll_policy: At observed rollover close old and open new, both fees/slippage; if new margin cannot be met unwind spot and old futures instead; actual broker rules unverified
score: sum completed cycle net / sum absolute original spot entry notional *100, unrounded
stress: Isolated adverse futures-only 5/7/10%; unchanged spot; worst maintenance headroom by held contract count, no assumed automatic margin transfer
margin_limitation: July 6..Aug 2 uses pre-existing inferred adjacent official schedule; daily settlement references official provided marks, not broker cash timestamp certification
stop: After regressions and A/B only; no sweep
